notes:
Summary: ZenByte builds an IntelliJ/PyCharm plugin (ZenAssist) that provides streaming token-level completions backed by a local file index. Primary goal is <100ms completion latency for single-line suggestions and continuous low-latency streaming for multi-line code generation.

Recent calls:
- 2025-02-20 discovery (Maya + CTO Arun Patel + engineering lead Sofia Ruiz). CTO: "We need a local-first experience — indexing on the developer machine and fall back to server model for heavy synthesis."
- 2025-03-01 demo: Redwood streaming + model pinning prototype. Live demo showed ~120ms median for short completions on Dedicated GPUs, still want <80ms.

Technical requirements/asks:
- Local indexing: plugin must keep a compact lexical + semantic index (embedding store) on the developer machine; ability to upload hashed metadata to Redwood for reranking/rate-limited cloud queries.
- Low-latency streaming: incremental token streaming via Redwood SDK to populate IntelliJ suggestions, must support SSE/WebSocket fallback for corporate networks.
- Model/version pinning: deterministic model selection per workspace; ability to pin to a quantized 7B model in Dedicated or fallback to hosted endpoint.
- Cost controls: developer seats ~150 engineers; need batching/caching recommendations from Redwood Optimize to reduce token costs across frequent small completions.
- Security: on-prem install option required for customers in regulated space; must integrate with company SSO (SAML) and use KMIP/HSM path for keys.

POC plan agreed: 2-week POC. Willow (ZenByte eng) will run plugin with Redwood Dedicated instance. Redwood SE (Liam) to supply perf-config and optimized batching flags. Focus metrics: 95th pct latency for first suggestion, tokens per session, and cost per 1000 completions.

Quotes / call notes:
- Sofia (Eng lead): "If we can get streaming that feels native (no lag) we can replace current Tabnine setup."
- Arun (CTO): "Data residency and audit logs are nonnegotiable — we need an on-prem path for enterprise customers."

Risks: legal hasn’t signed on to on-prem deployment; current SAML provider uses custom attributes that require mapping in Redwood Console. Engineering: cold-start model weights on laptop is out — prefer Dedicated for model host and local index only on client.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to deliver Dedicated perf config and a short runbook for plugin integration (Liam) — due 2025-03-07.
- ZenByte to provide sample repo (~50k LOC) for indexing POC by 2025-03-06.
- Schedule security questionnaire deep-dive with security team (target 2025-03-10).
